references.text: The lot was also cast for the tribe of Manasseh, showing the same system for distributing land among the tribes
Describes how the tribe of Benjamin received its portion by casting lots, the same method used for Asher
The second lot fell on Simeon, showing the order of casting lots for the tribes
The third lot came up for the children of Zebulun, continuing the sequence of tribal allocations
The fourth lot fell on Issachar, the verse right before Asher's lot as the fifth
The sixth lot fell on the children of Naphtali, continuing the sequence after Asher
The birth and naming of Asher, the patriarch of the tribe of Asher mentioned here
The census of the tribe of Asher according to their families, as mentioned in this verse
